task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Bring the sauce can with red lid over and set it near the kitchenpot with plastic knob on lid
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将带有红色盖子的酱罐放在靠近带有塑料旋钮的厨房锅附近
